title: Evaluation under shifted gate references
statement: Let $x$ assign a value in a commutative ring to each of $n$ inputs, let $v$ and $w$ be lists of ring elements, and let $g$ be an algebraic gate. If every node reference in $g$ is increased by the length of $v$, then evaluating the shifted gate on the concatenated list $v$ followed by $w$ gives the same value as evaluating $g$ on $w$.
